erp.title: Build your ERP around the work your factory does every day.
erp.description: Nexus Open-source ERP is planned to connect HR, attendance, shifts, purchasing and inventory. Manufacturers with an IT team can plan to self-host or discuss migration and implementation support with Asper.
erp.demoNote: The Nexus page presents system concepts and sample data. The open-source product has not been released.

status.title: Confirm the scope before you plan adoption.
status.description: We can discuss factory requirements and adoption conditions now. Public source code, deployment documentation and downloads will accompany the release.
status.hosting: Self-hosted and maintained by the factory

erp.scopeDescription: The first release focuses on Taiwan factories with shift work. Shared scope also includes calendars, expense claims and role-based permissions so IT, HR and managers can work from the same records.

modules.title: People and attendance
modules.description: Organize staff, teams and time-clock sources. HR reviews attendance records and exceptions.

modules.title: Shifts, leave and overtime
modules.description: Map shifts to workdays. Employees submit requests for supervisors to approve.

modules.title: Payroll and approvals
modules.description: Connect approved attendance, leave and overtime records to payroll preparation, with supporting records.

modules.title: Purchasing and inventory
modules.description: Connect requisitions, quotations, purchase orders and receipts with supplier, material and stock records.

workflow.title: From shift schedules to a month-end you can review.
workflow.description: This is the planned attendance workflow. Adoption starts by confirming time-clock sources, working-hour arrangements and opening balances.

steps.title: Set up people and shifts
steps.description: HR confirms teams, reporting lines, shifts and workdays.

steps.title: Import and review clock records
steps.description: HR checks shifts and handles missing or overnight clock records.

steps.title: Complete requests and approvals
steps.description: Employees and supervisors confirm leave, overtime and time off in lieu.

steps.title: Review month-end records
steps.description: HR and finance review settlement records before payroll preparation.

preparation.title: Bring these details to the first conversation.
preparation.description: Asper confirms how your factory works before assessing implementation scope.
items: Staff, teams and supervisor approval workflows
Shifts, working-hour arrangements and time-clock export formats
Opening balances for leave, time off in lieu and inventory
Owners for deployment, backups, updates and daily maintenance

agent.title: Where the adoption assistant will fit
agent.description: A future website agent will use public documentation and factory requirements to help prepare deployment and data checklists. Answers will link to their documentation sources.
agent.status: This is a planned workflow. Asper staff currently handle adoption discussions.

services.title: Clear scopes for the open-source product and paid services.
services.description: Factories can plan to self-host. When Asper support is needed, we confirm the project scope and quote based on data and maintenance requirements.

items.title: Migration and deployment
items.description: Confirm existing formats, import scope and opening balances, then plan deployment and acceptance.

items.title: Workflow setup and training
items.description: Review workflows with HR, supervisors and IT so the owners can complete one operating cycle.

items.title: Updates and maintenance support
items.description: Define responsibilities for backups, version updates and support based on factory needs.

esg.title: Next, put the records to work for ESG delivery.
esg.description: Purchasing and inventory can provide part of the ESG data. A carbon inventory also needs fuel consumption and energy records. Product carbon footprints need product, process and allocation data. Asper assesses connections for the required outcome.

questions.title: Can I download the open-source version now?
questions.answer: The public version has not been released. Apache-2.0 is the planned license. You can view the Nexus concept demo and discuss early adoption conditions with Asper.

questions.title: Does the first release support flexible working-hour arrangements?
questions.answer: The first release does not support flexible working-hour arrangements. Asper will confirm your factory's arrangements before assessing whether adoption is suitable.

questions.title: Can we use ESG services with our existing ERP?
questions.answer: We can discuss connections from your existing ERP, Excel or supporting documents. ESG projects confirm data needs for the required deliverable, so the factory can keep its existing systems.

questions.title: How does Asper access data in a self-hosted factory?
questions.answer: The factory manages its self-hosted data. Implementation or ESG services require a separate agreement on authorized data, purpose and service scope.

contact.title: Start with one factory operating cycle.
contact.description: Tell us about your HR or purchasing challenges, working-hour arrangements and IT maintenance setup. Asper will help confirm the scope and preparation needed.

esg.title: Turn factory records into ESG deliverables.
esg.description: Start with a specific customer requirement. Asper helps confirm data sources, identify missing records and review supporting evidence, then prepares traceability evidence, carbon inventory working papers or product carbon footprint data within the agreed scope.

entry.title: Keep your ERP. Connect the data you need.
entry.description: Use your existing ERP, Excel and source documents. Asper confirms delivery requirements and data gaps before planning connections.
entry.start: A defined period, site or product
entry.delivery: Project scope and quote agreed first

outcomes.title: First, define the work your factory needs to complete.
outcomes.description: Each outcome needs different data and review steps. Asper assesses the project based on the recipient, deadline and available records.

waste.title: Waste and recycling traceability
waste.summary: Connect batches, weights, handovers and treatment records into traceable evidence.
waste.audience: FOR PLANT OPERATIONS, EHS AND ESG TEAMS
waste.description: Respond to customer requests about destinations and recycling. Asper connects available records and identifies missing handover or treatment evidence.
inputs: Batch, material classification and weight records
Delivery period, customer requirements and record owners
outputs: Period traceability register with source references
Batch evidence package reviewed by the factory
waste.nextStep: Choose a period or batch, then confirm customer requirements and available handover and treatment records.

carbon.title: Factory carbon inventory
carbon.summary: Prepare fuel and energy activity data with sources, periods and reviewable working papers.
carbon.audience: FOR ESG, FINANCE, OPERATIONS AND IT
carbon.description: Asper maps sources to the inventory boundary and period. Purchasing, stock and energy documents each need review to produce usable activity data.
inputs: Inventory boundary, period and emission-source register
Fuel consumption, purchases and opening and closing stock
Electricity and other energy consumption with supporting documents
Factor sources, versions and original evidence
outputs: Factor versions, missing records and review history
Carbon inventory working papers within the agreed scope
carbon.nextStep: Confirm the site, period and deadline. Use one month's fuel and energy records to discuss the scope.

pcf.title: Product carbon footprint (PCF)
pcf.summary: Start with one product and prepare the basis for material, process and energy allocation calculations.
pcf.audience: FOR SALES, PRODUCT AND ESG TEAMS
pcf.description: When a customer requests product data, Asper helps confirm the product boundary and data gaps before assessing a single-product pilot.
inputs: Selected product, customer requirements and product boundary
Bill of materials, consumption, supplier and transport data
Allocation method, factors and original evidence
outputs: Product data requirements and missing-record checklist
Reviewed material, process and allocation settings
Calculation data and evidence package within the agreed scope
pcf.nextStep: Choose one product, then compare customer requirements with material and output records to define the pilot.

workflow.title: Every deliverable can link back to its sources.
workflow.description: Asper and factory owners confirm sources, gaps, reviews and outputs together.

steps.title: Confirm data sources
steps.description: The factory provides authorized ERP, Excel, documents or records.

steps.title: Organize periods and fields
steps.description: Asper maps periods, units and formats while preserving sources.

steps.title: Complete and review records
steps.description: Factory owners provide missing records and confirm data and calculation inputs.

steps.title: Deliver and maintain
steps.description: Both teams confirm the outcome and plan the next period's updates and delivery.

agent.title: AI agents will assist with preparation and follow-up.
agent.description: Planned agents will help map fields, track missing records and draft deliverables with links to source evidence. A calculation engine performs calculations. Factory staff review and approve the results.
agent.status: This is a planned workflow. A production agent service is not yet available.

service.title: Define paid scope around your factory's required outcome.
service.description: Asper first reviews the outcome, data volume and deadline. The project starts after both teams confirm scope and quote.
service.initialDescription: Confirm fields, import data, preserve sources and set up reviews to complete the first agreed deliverable.
service.ongoingDescription: Plan preparation, updates and ongoing use for new periods, products or sources as needed.
service.scopeNote: Software, consultant collaboration and third-party verification work and fees are agreed separately for each project.

esg.faqTitle: Questions to settle before you start

questions.title: Do we need to adopt Nexus ERP first?
questions.answer: You can start with your existing ERP, Excel or documents. Asper assesses connections based on available data and delivery requirements. ESG projects can work with your existing systems.

questions.title: Are purchasing and stock records enough for a carbon inventory or PCF?
questions.answer: Purchasing and stock records provide only part of the data. Carbon inventories also need energy and actual consumption records. PCF also needs product boundaries, materials, output, processes and allocation inputs.

questions.title: How do we define the first project?
questions.answer: Confirm one delivery requirement, an owner and a deadline, then select a period, site or product. Asper proposes a scope based on available data and gaps.

questions.title: Does delivery include third-party verification?
questions.answer: Data preparation, working papers and calculation evidence follow the project agreement. Consultant and third-party verification scope, responsibilities and fees are confirmed separately.

contact.title: Start with the ESG request in front of you.
contact.description: Tell us the recipient, deadline, site or product, and your current ERP, Excel or documents. Asper will help define the first deliverable.
